immediate_genre_legibility.justification: Observation: kitchen night, snow window, stove/hearth, two adults, laptop, lantern read as contemporary-rural graphic novel, not LitRPG. Actstage forest stills read as moody fantasy-drama. Genre is legible as quiet character comic; it is not manhwa-action.

opening_hook.justification: Observation: inspected accepted set starts mid-kitchen, not a cold open. p08 two-shot has atmosphere (back, lamp, not-looking). No page-one hook comparable to a serial first-scroll. Inference: sample is a research kitchen sequence, not a chapter open.

emotional_engagement.justification: Observation: p08 and page01_p08 carry actual blocking — Soren withdrawn, Sigrid watching, space between them. More acted than Ember scowls. Limited to one mood (estrangement).

curiosity_and_chapter_end_propulsion.justification: Observation: p10 is Sigrid at the fire, Soren at a desk. No cliff, no new information beat. Four frames do not end a chapter.

memorability.justification: Observation: lantern, plaid, laptop-in-cabin, ink blacks are specific. More memorable than Ember's interchangeable dungeon stills. Not a franchise-level image yet.

desire_to_continue_reading.justification: Observation: I would look at the next kitchen frame for the argument. There is no next fight, no world expand on these pages. Desire is local, not serial.

panel_to_panel_causality.justification: Observation: people move (table to stove to stool) but rooms rewrite between p06/p07/p10, so causes are hard to trust. Acting continues; space does not.

spatial_continuity.justification: Observation: wood stove vs brick fireplace, door placement, shelf walls, and table geometry change across four 'same kitchen' frames. The set is not locked.

acting_and_reaction_clarity.justification: Observation: not-looking, chin-on-hand, seated slump are readable. No dialogue to confirm the argument, but body language is the strongest in the corpus for quiet scenes.

shot_and_rhythm_variation.justification: Observation: mostly wide rooms plus one tighter two-shot. No close-up/insert/over-shoulder rhythm of a comic scene.

vertical_pacing.justification: Observation: landscape 3:2-ish frames, no vertical reader, no gutters. Dimension cannot function as a webtoon scroll.

quiet_spectacle_contrast.justification: Observation: kitchen is all quiet. Actstage forest stills are spectacle-adjacent but not in the same sequence. No contrast inside the accepted set.

action_choreography.justification: Observation: no attack/counter on inspected pages.

visual_economy.justification: Observation: rooms are busy with props but blacks crop well. Compared with Ember's all-over stone, this is more economical. Still fully rendered illustrations, not comics shorthand.

character_appeal.justification: Observation: Sigrid's hair/lantern/plaid and Soren's coat-back are appealing as graphic-novel adults. Not anime-pretty. Sample too small for serial magnetism.

distinctive_silhouettes.justification: Observation: lantern-Sigrid vs seated-Soren reads at thumbnail. Actstage coat-man is generic.

face_hair_costume_consistency.justification: Observation: identities hold; coat color, stove, and room dressing do not. Sigrid hair is consistent enough.

anatomy_and_hands.justification: Observation: no sausage-hand disaster like Ember p013. Hands holding lantern/laptop are simplified ink, acceptable. Limited poses.

line_and_shape_confidence.justification: Observation: ink contour and black grouping look like a chosen drawing method. Stronger line confidence than Ember cel-paint or City airbrush.

value_hierarchy.justification: Observation: lamp/fire vs unlit wood is a real value plan. Characters sit in light. This is the best value work inspected.

color_script.justification: Observation: orange interior vs cool door/window. Limited palette. p10 fireplace orange is the same script in a different room.

environment_integration.justification: Observation: people sit in the rooms, occlusion works in p07/p08. Integration fails because the room is not one place.

monster_and_gear_design.justification: Observation: no monster. Props (laptop, lantern, mug) are ordinary. Actstage geometric overlay is not gear design.

controlled_detail.justification: Observation: shelves and grain are busy but blacks rest the eye. Not Ember's all-over crackle.

absence_of_generic_ai_painting_signature.justification: Observation: ink method avoids the prestige-dungeon face. Residual AI: room mutation, slightly plastic faces, actstage webtoon coat-man is generic. Not clean of the medium.

system_clarity.justification: Observation: no status, XP, class, or system UI on inspected pages.

items_gear_skills_with_meaningful_choice.justification: Observation: mug, laptop, lantern exist as props, not choices.

understandable_stakes_and_constraints.justification: Observation: night, cold door, two people not talking. Emotional stakes only. No rules.

balance_between_system_information_and_d.justification: Observation: no system information to balance.

balloon_shape_and_placement.justification: Observation: no balloons on accepted rasters.

sfx_integration.justification: Observation: no SFX lettering on the accepted kitchen rasters or actstage stills.

system_ui_distinction_and_originality.justification: Observation: no system UI, HUD, or interface chrome on the inspected North Garden pages.

negative_space_planning.justification: Observation: darks could hold lettering; nothing is planned as a balloon well.

phone_readability.justification: Observation: landscape frames with no 390 reader. Tiny figures in wide rooms would die on a phone.

scroll_rhythm_and_loading_experience.justification: Observation: no HTML scroll stack for these rasters.

localization_resilience.justification: Observation: no separable lettering layer on the accepted pages.

repeatability.justification: Inference from visible pages: four frames of one room still mutate architecture, so the local/control stack is not repeating a set.

editability.justification: Inference: pagecomp vs pagecomp3 show restages, not layered edits. No SVG lettering to edit.

art_directability.justification: Observation: ink look is directed. Actstage shows style branching (webtoon/painted) as whole-image swaps, not controls.

correction_cost.justification: Inference: fixing the kitchen would mean regenerating rooms, not nudging a 3D camera — the accepted frames already disagree.

identity_and_continuity_control.justification: Observation: people roughly persist; set does not. That is a failed continuity-control demonstration.

throughput.justification: Observation: visible accepted comic pages are a handful, not a chapter.

sustainable_human_review_load.justification: Inference: every frame needs a set-continuity check that currently fails.

reproducibility.justification: Inference: local pipeline is more inspectable than imagegen-default Ember, but accepted hashes still sit on mutated rooms.

rights_provenance_confidence.justification: Inference: original characters, local research edition, no third-party comic panels on these pages. Not a legal clearance.

maintainability.justification: Inference: scattered pagecomp/pagecomp3/actstage folders, no lettered reader, small accepted set.

immediate_genre_legibility.justification: Observation: crane harbor, scheduled 'down,' pins, bells, stained work coat. Reads immediately as industrial-fantasy labor, not generic dungeon LitRPG.

opening_hook.justification: Observation: skyline then Mae on a singing pin then early bell. Specific. Hook is world-texture more than a plot turn. Empty balloons blunt the first-scroll punch.

emotional_engagement.justification: Observation: Mae's body strain and the CH03 slab rescue are felt. Faces are stylized, not deep acting, but labor is emotional.

curiosity_and_chapter_end_propulsion.justification: Observation: EAST LEAN: SEVERE and the collapsing stairs want a next beat. Phone strip ends in more dock work rather than a hard button. CH03 contact implies aftermath/care.

memorability.justification: Observation: Mae, the coral/teal print, the bell, the slab. This is the most memorable drawing language in-scope.

desire_to_continue_reading.justification: Observation: I want the next physical problem. Empty lettering and caption-under-art fight that desire on every panel.

panel_to_panel_causality.justification: Observation: pin-singing to early bell to stairs resigning is causal. CH03 rope/weight/rescue is the clearest cause-effect sheet inspected. Still one-illustration-per-panel, not in-panel motion.

spatial_continuity.justification: Observation: dock, crane, water, stairs stay a place. Costume continuity is high. Not immune to generator drift, but far above Ember's room resets.

acting_and_reaction_clarity.justification: Observation: squat, reach, brace, haul are readable. Dax's scarf/clock separate him. Not subtle facial acting.

shot_and_rhythm_variation.justification: Observation: wide harbor, tool close-up, two-shot stairs, overhead lean, rescue. Squares limit cinematic variety but the content varies.

vertical_pacing.justification: Observation: phone strip is equal squares with caption bands. No tall splash vs short beat. Readable, metronomic.

quiet_spectacle_contrast.justification: Observation: tool close-ups vs slab/kaiju spectacle. Contrast exists. CH10 fail spectacle is the wrong monster.

action_choreography.justification: Observation: CH03 is physical choreography (rope directions, shared load). Not martial-arts beat-by-beat, but not Ember levitation either.

impact_and_aftermath.justification: Observation: flying tools/bell, people under stone, aftercare on the contact sheet. Aftermath is present. Lettering does not land the hits.

visual_economy.justification: Observation: print texture is dense but shapes are big (coat, crane, water). Blank lettering boxes waste composition on every page.

character_appeal.justification: Observation: Mae is a protagonist, not a mannequin. Appeal is craft-and-body, not pretty-boy. Would not embarrass a mid-tier indie print comic on character.

distinctive_silhouettes.justification: Observation: yellow coat + teal harness vs red scarf + clock-gauntlet reads at thumbnail in every two-shot.

face_hair_costume_consistency.justification: Observation: braids, hoop, coat stains, Dax scarf hold across CH01/CH03. Crowd extras are looser. CH10 fail adds extra bodies in similar palettes.

anatomy_and_hands.justification: Observation: working hands on pins and ropes are the point and mostly work. Stylized, not academic. Better than Ember p013.

line_and_shape_confidence.justification: Observation: carved blacks, poster shapes, intentional print noise. A designed language.

value_hierarchy.justification: Observation: figures vs water/sky generally separate. Some mid-value mud in crowds. Blank boxes punch holes in the value plan.

color_script.justification: Observation: coral, teal, dirty yellow, black. Held across chapters. Distinct from every other pipeline.

environment_integration.justification: Observation: people stand on docks that exist. Cranes, rails, water contact. Not pasted on a cyclorama.

monster_and_gear_design.justification: Observation: tools/pins/bells are excellent gear. CH10 kaiju is generic and labeled a fail. No original creature success in the inspected sample.

controlled_detail.justification: Observation: texture is a style, not accidental grit. Still busy. Empty boxes are uncontrolled holes.

absence_of_generic_ai_painting_signature.justification: Observation: print treatment hides the usual smooth-face dungeon look. Remaining signatures: reserved blank rectangles, occasional mush in crowds, generic kaiju fail.

system_clarity.justification: Observation: EAST LEAN: SEVERE and pin arrows are diegetic-ish rules. Not a HUD. Readable if you accept captions as the system.

progression_satisfaction.justification: Observation: CH03 shows harder physical problems, not levels. Satisfaction is labor, not numbers. Sample is light.

combat_application_of_progression.justification: Observation: skills are rope/weight, applied in the rescue. No combat class. CH10 fail is creature spectacle without a readable skill.

items_gear_skills_with_meaningful_choice.justification: Observation: pins, ropes, bells, clocks are choices you can see. Stronger object storytelling than Ember's glowing menus.

understandable_stakes_and_constraints.justification: Observation: early bell, resigned stairs, lean, drowning under stone. Stakes are physical and clear.

balance_between_system_information_and_d.justification: Observation: almost no HUD clutter. Drama is undercut by empty balloons, not by UI.

balloon_shape_and_placement.justification: Observation: every inspected lettered panel has a blank paper rectangle in the art. Real copy sits under the border. That is broken comics lettering.

tail_attribution.justification: Observation: no tails. Attribution is a label under the panel (MAE, DAX, WORKER). Functional as a script, not as balloons.

type_hierarchy.justification: Observation: caption vs speaker vs SFX vs DIEGETIC labels exist under the art. Inside the panel there is no type hierarchy because there is no type.

sfx_integration.justification: Observation: KONNNG is a caption, not integrated SFX. The bell drawing does the sound; the type does not live in the splash.

system_ui_distinction_and_originality.justification: Observation: EAST LEAN and pin arrows are original. They are still captions/overlays, not a designed UI language.

negative_space_planning.justification: Observation: boxes are reserved, so planning exists. The reserved space is unused, which is worse than no plan.

phone_readability.justification: Observation: 390-ish strip of squares plus cream caption bands is readable as a contact strip. Empty in-art boxes are large wounds at phone size.

scroll_rhythm_and_loading_experience.justification: Observation: equal squares, caption under each, no live HTML panel stack inspected beyond the PNG strip. Metronomic.

localization_resilience.justification: Observation: under-panel captions would be easy to translate. In-art boxes have no live text. Mixed.

repeatability.justification: Inference: print language and costume lock repeat across CH01/CH03. Creature fail shows the lock is not total.

editability.justification: Observation: lettering is not in a vector overlay on these PNGs; it is burned blank boxes plus external captions. Hard to relight or reletter in-place.

art_directability.justification: Observation: the print look is a real direction that survived many panels. That is more art-directable than Ember's default dungeon.

correction_cost.justification: Observation: CH10 creature fail is preserved as a strip regen. Failures look like full re-draws.

identity_and_continuity_control.justification: Observation: Mae/Dax identity holds. Better than Ember. Not perfect in crowds/kaiju.

throughput.justification: Inference: ten-chapter folders exist with 30 lettered panels each. High volume for the style. Visual-A sampled CH01+CH03+fail.

sustainable_human_review_load.justification: Observation: empty balloons are a systematic miss a reviewer must catch every time. Creature fails too.

reproducibility.justification: Inference: generative rasters, no seed on the pages. Same class of unreproducible stills as Ember, with a stronger style prompt.

rights_provenance_confidence.justification: Inference: original leads, no third-party pages in the sample. Not clearance.

maintainability.justification: Observation: lettered PNG + phone strip + contact sheets. No SVG lettering layer. Caption-under-art is a maintainable hack and a comics dead end.

immediate_genre_legibility.justification: Observation: sky-road, glowing pylons, witness-cuff. Reads as prestige painted webtoon fantasy immediately. Also reads as generic floating-city fantasy.

opening_hook.justification: Observation: Sola finds a seam, talks to Witness, crowd runs, pylon breaks. A real first-chapter shape. Landscape stills and small faces on phone weaken the hook.

emotional_engagement.justification: Observation: headache close-up and two-shot ritual have faces. Most frames are the same alert look. Better than Ember's mannequin, less than Mae's body-acting.

curiosity_and_chapter_end_propulsion.justification: Observation: CH01 compact lettering ends on 'Witness. Below.' CH08 later chapter is pretty talk, low propulsion visually.

memorability.justification: Observation: Sola's streak/cuff and the cloud road stick. The city itself is interchangeable luminous gothic.

desire_to_continue_reading.justification: Observation: I would scroll CH01. CH04/CH08 contact sheets look like the same painting session. Desire drops when every page is a dusk beauty still.

panel_to_panel_causality.justification: Observation: seam-find to alarm to pylon-break is a chain of stills, not cuts that carry bodies. Each frame re-poses Sola.

spatial_continuity.justification: Observation: the road, city, and two leads persist. Better than Ember pits. Camera side and crowd positions drift.

acting_and_reaction_clarity.justification: Observation: temple-clutch, reach toward falling pylon, crossed-arm watch. Readable. Range is narrow.

shot_and_rhythm_variation.justification: Observation: contact sheets are almost all the same landscape illustration ratio. Some close-ups exist. No true tall/short webtoon rhythm.

vertical_pacing.justification: Observation: phone preview stacks landscape paintings. Each beat is short on a 390-wide screen (wide image, little height). Not a designed vertical page.

quiet_spectacle_contrast.justification: Observation: headache quiet vs pylon break. CH08 is all quiet glow. Spectacle is sparkle, not scale-contrast.

action_choreography.justification: Observation: pylon explosion and CH04 leap are posed stills with debris/glow. No attack-counter-reversal chain.

impact_and_aftermath.justification: Observation: debris reads. Aftermath is more standing-and-talking. No body-cost like Ember's rib or Borrowed Down's slab.

visual_economy.justification: Observation: every panel is a fully painted widescreen illustration. Sky, architecture, cloth texture always on. No economy.

character_appeal.justification: Observation: Sola is attractive and identifiable. Appeal is painted-pretty, not a comic icon. Staff-man is a solid second.

distinctive_silhouettes.justification: Observation: braid + long blue coat + cuff; white coat + looped staff. Good. Crowds in matching blues flatten.

face_hair_costume_consistency.justification: Observation: streak, braid, cuff, staff persist CH01–CH08. Better than Ember hair-color drift. Faces still share a renderer.

anatomy_and_hands.justification: Observation: hands on seams and keys are better than Ember p013. Leap-hand in CH04 is large/soft. No disaster frames in the sample.

line_and_shape_confidence.justification: Observation: painted edges, little ink. Shapes are pretty, not carved. Soft compared with North Garden and Borrowed Down.

value_hierarchy.justification: Observation: dusk skies vs lit faces usually work. Glow effects compete. Grayscale not inspected as a file; inference from color stills: mid-value heavy.

color_script.justification: Observation: dusk blue-gold CH01, cooler interiors CH04, night teal CH08. A script, also a genre default.

environment_integration.justification: Observation: figures stand on the road; reflections and scale are mostly believed. Better paste-up than Ember cream cutouts.

monster_and_gear_design.justification: Observation: cuff, staff, crystal key, pylons. Elegant, generic. No creature in the sampled chapters.

controlled_detail.justification: Observation: architecture filigree and cloth always dense. Pretty noise. Less ember-speckle than Ember, still not spare.

absence_of_generic_ai_painting_signature.justification: Observation: this is the prestige-AI painted webtoon look — smooth skin, luminous city, same three-quarter, glow magic. Strong convergence.

system_clarity.justification: Observation: Witness-cuff and road-seams are the system. No numbers. Clear as magic-tech, not as a readable rule sheet.

progression_satisfaction.justification: Observation: CH04/CH08 show more ritual/table work, not a visible upgrade of Sola. Bandaged arm in CH04 contact is a cost, not a level.

combat_application_of_progression.justification: Observation: almost no combat application. Glow and reach, not a skill used to win a fight.

items_gear_skills_with_meaningful_choice.justification: Observation: key, staff, cuff. Choices are talked around tables more than demonstrated.

understandable_stakes_and_constraints.justification: Observation: falling pylon, stranded people, 'the cable is coming apart.' Stakes exist; rules of Witness are foggy on the page.

balance_between_system_information_and_d.justification: Observation: no HUD cards. Drama is faces and road. Better balance than Ember overlays — because there is almost no system text.

balloon_shape_and_placement.justification: Observation: real rounded balloons with names on the lettered review and phone strip. Placement is often floating top-center, not mouth-locked, but they are actual balloons.

tail_attribution.justification: Observation: tails are weak/short; speaker chips (SOLA, HAMN) do the work. Better than Borrowed Down's none.

type_hierarchy.justification: Observation: caption boxes (teal), dialogue (white), SFX (KRAK, TIK, SSSSK) are distinct on the strip.

sfx_integration.justification: Observation: SFX exists and is sparse. Still typeset, not drawn into the burst.

system_ui_distinction_and_originality.justification: Observation: Witness lines are captions, not a UI. Cuff glow is the in-world system. Fine, not original HUD craft.

negative_space_planning.justification: Observation: big skies leave room, and balloons use it. Faces sometimes fight copy on the compact sheet.

phone_readability.justification: Observation: prebaked 390 strip of landscape art. Type on the strip is readable. Faces are small except dedicated close-ups. Viewer desktop is 960px.

scroll_rhythm_and_loading_experience.justification: Observation: one PNG per chapter for phone, one for full. Simple loading. Rhythm is equal landscape beats. Viewer has mode switch and shimmer loader.

localization_resilience.justification: Observation: lettering appears composited into preview PNGs, not a live SVG overlay. Translating means rebuilding the strip.

repeatability.justification: Observation: look and leads repeat for 10 chapter folders. That is a repeatable style. It is also a repeatable generic look.

editability.justification: Observation: lettering in baked previews. Source panels are unlettered paintings. Relight/repose is a regen.

art_directability.justification: Observation: palette and costume hold, which is direction. Staging does not appear steered beyond 'beautiful wide shot.'

correction_cost.justification: Inference: painted full frames; a hand fix is a new image. No failures gallery inspected for this pipeline.

identity_and_continuity_control.justification: Observation: Sola/staff-man identity is the best of the painted pipelines. Background extras less so.

throughput.justification: Inference: 10×24 panels plus review sheets and phone strips. High throughput.

sustainable_human_review_load.justification: Observation: every frame is a dense painting. Review is 'is this still pretty and the same person,' not comics staging — still a lot of looking.

reproducibility.justification: Inference: generative paintings, unreproducible per frame.

rights_provenance_confidence.justification: Inference: original cast on inspected pages. Not clearance.

maintainability.justification: Observation: real viewer, chapter folders, review sheets. More productized than North Garden. Lettering baked into previews hurts maintainability.

immediate_genre_legibility.justification: Observation: pit, chains, salvage coat, Belljaw, ember cracks. LitRPG-dungeon fantasy is immediate. Also immediate as generic prestige dungeon.

opening_hook.justification: Observation: p001 pit is a real open; p004 monster lands. Tiny figures plus a 7-line caption on p001 waste the hook. Still the strongest Ember open.

emotional_engagement.justification: Observation: faces are stock. p017 bind-ribs is the only tender beat. Dialogue overlays are clever, not acted.

curiosity_and_chapter_end_propulsion.justification: Observation: CH10 p024 is a group poster into an orange door. CH04 p018 (Sable wins) is the actual curiosity still. Most chapter ends on the contact sheets are standing-in-architecture.

memorability.justification: Observation: Belljaw and the pit stick. Elian's face does not. Volume is memorable as a dungeon brochure.

desire_to_continue_reading.justification: Observation: stills attract; after a dozen same-lit posters the scroll is tiring. Not a serial pull.

panel_to_panel_causality.justification: Observation: intended beats exist (charge, clamp, scan, slide, hang, spend, finish). Drawings drop the stage between them, so causality is caption-causal, not picture-causal.

spatial_continuity.justification: Observation: p007–p008 cream cyclorama, p010 outdoor sky, pit elsewhere. Contact sheet makes the jump obvious. Serial-stopping.

acting_and_reaction_clarity.justification: Observation: spear plant and hit-grimace read. Most frames are the same scowl. Reactions do not chain.

shot_and_rhythm_variation.justification: Observation: some wides and close-ups (p001 vs p013). Default is a 2:3 fashion-illustration of one to three figures. No comic panel scale language.

vertical_pacing.justification: Observation: phone column stacks equal full-bleed illustrations with 12px gutters. No short/tall beats. Sticky nav eats height.

quiet_spectacle_contrast.justification: Observation: coin close-up vs combo vs item tray. Quiet stills are still fully rendered and textured. Contrast of subject, not of density.

action_choreography.justification: Observation: attack/counter is a list of poses. CH03 beam/shield/kill similarly resets floors. Not choreographed motion.

impact_and_aftermath.justification: Observation: p015 burst and p016 tableau; CH04 p018 is aftermath-as-theft. Impacts are illustrated, not felt through a sequence.

visual_economy.justification: Observation: every panel is a complete painting. Stone cracks everywhere. No speed-panel, no silhouette panel, no rest.

character_appeal.justification: Observation: handsome, generic. Mira's undercut helps. Elian is a stock LitRPG cover boy. Not magnetic.

distinctive_silhouettes.justification: Observation: Belljaw and Mira's T-shield are distinct. Elian coat is a rectangle. CH10 party is four standing adults.

face_hair_costume_consistency.justification: Observation: Elian is recognizable. Mira hair orange vs red. Coat tatter and belt kit flicker. Consistency is 'same generator,' not a model sheet.

anatomy_and_hands.justification: Observation: p013 hands are below bar (huge, poorly articulated). Other frames are acceptable fashion anatomy. Recurring issue, not a one-off.

line_and_shape_confidence.justification: Observation: charcoal contour is a real choice and holds. Stone masses sometimes mush.

value_hierarchy.justification: Observation: ember orange pops. Mid-gray stone often swallows figures. Cream-field p007 is ironically clearer.

color_script.justification: Observation: teal/ivory/brass/ember holds ten chapters. CH03 cooler, CH05 warmer. A script, also a template.

environment_integration.justification: Observation: p001 integrates. p007 cutouts and p010 sky do not. People often look placed on dungeons.

monster_and_gear_design.justification: Observation: Belljaw, Glassback, split shield, item tray, Sable's kit. Best Ember art-direction channel. Still one material family.

controlled_detail.justification: Observation: crackle and ember flecks on everything. Eyestrain on contact sheets.

absence_of_generic_ai_painting_signature.justification: Observation: repeated face, smooth skin, cracked-stone dungeon, cream cutouts, floating poses, outdoor-in-pit. Generic AI prestige-fantasy, charcoal-cel flavor.

system_clarity.justification: Observation: HUD card on p002 works. p019 'class terminal' is a glowing split circle with empty SVG. ch05 p022 overlay empty. Numbers live in HTML chips. Mixed, often off-page.

progression_satisfaction.justification: Observation: LV3→LV8 is in the hub table. Visually Elian is the same coat. CH05 tray/craft is the only satisfying object progression.

combat_application_of_progression.justification: Observation: Fault Sight as an orange line is the clearest skill picture. Fault Step is a jump-pose. CH10 beam is a laser, not a readable technique.

items_gear_skills_with_meaningful_choice.justification: Observation: seals vs talisman, inventory tray, spear/shield. Choices are written; some objects show them. p013 does not clearly show which item is spent.

understandable_stakes_and_constraints.justification: Observation: void, cracked rib, HP chips, failed race. Constraints exist. Visual cost is often a glow or a pose.

balance_between_system_information_and_d.justification: Observation: long dialogue balloons dump system talk onto faces. Some system beats have zero overlay. Drama and UI both lose.

balloon_shape_and_placement.justification: Observation: rectangles/butted shapes, 4px stroke, 84% ivory. p003 two 9-line balloons on a two-shot. Functional overlay, not professional balloon craft.

tail_attribution.justification: Observation: triangular tails exist. Dual balloons on p003 are only roughly aimed. Mixed open-caption vs balloon on p013.

type_hierarchy.justification: Observation: Arial everywhere. Gold HUD vs black balloon vs stroked open text. Hierarchy is color, not type design. One size (~36.8) for essays.

sfx_integration.justification: Observation: fight panels use stroked dialogue paragraphs, not SFX. Volume has almost no integrated sound type.

system_ui_distinction_and_originality.justification: Observation: brass-edged dark cards are distinct from balloons. Generic RPG HUD. Several system panels have no card at all.

negative_space_planning.justification: Observation: p002 left void is used. Most art is not composed for balloons; lettering is dropped on after. p013 balloon is huge because the renderer found empty pixels.

phone_readability.justification: Observation: CSS phone width is 430px, not 390. 36.8pt in 1024 viewBox ~14–15px. Fine for two lines; p003/p013 dumps fail. This worktree has no experiments/ rasters, so local HTML cannot show art.

scroll_rhythm_and_loading_experience.justification: Observation: 24 equal posters/chapter; read-all is 240. Lazy-load plus double PNG+SVG. Sticky nav. No gutter rhythm. Heavy.

localization_resilience.justification: Observation: SVG text is editable and separated from (intended) rasters. Balloon boxes are fitted to English 8-line dumps and will overflow. Best Ember localization story, still cramped.

repeatability.justification: Observation: style repeats; rooms and hands do not. Repeatable look, not repeatable scenes.

editability.justification: Observation: vector lettering/UI is the editable part. Rasters are flat. That split is real craft in the pipeline.

art_directability.justification: Observation: Candidate B palette holds. Staging direction does not survive generation (cream fields, sky).
